title: Bezos's grandfather Lawrence Gise ran the AEC's Western Division

tellings.quote: He was the director of the Western Division. Uh Harold Mgrren told me that story.

plain: Jeff Bezos's grandfather, Lawrence Preston Gise, is said to have been director of the Western Division of the Atomic Energy Commission, the US body that ran nuclear research, in the 1960s. The commentator Matthew Pines says the former government trade official Harold Malmgren told him this. If true, it would tie the family of one of the world's richest men to secret government science.
